source.rationale: The numbers ARE the pick affordance: compile-current-state persists compatible_entities as the roster in the same order, and the customer's next reply is resolved positionally against it. So this node may only ever APPEND a suffix - never reorder, renumber, or touch a non-numbered line. Two non-numbered lines are present on purpose: the R3 'Couldn't find:' prepend the gate adds when a filter was lost on a picker turn, and the picker's own header. Both must come through untouched; annotating the header would put '- no delivery' on a sentence, and annotating the R3 line would claim a delivery verdict about a token that does not exist. RETUNED 2026-08-25 (90-day probe window): the probe now always sends a delivery-date window - the parser's own bounds, else an injected last-90-days default - so the miss suffix and the zero-hit close are scoped to that window ('- no delivery in the last 90 days'); a bare '- no delivery' would be a false universal, the probe never looked further back. The parser ctx entry here carries NEITHER date bound, which is exactly the defaulted-window case; hand-annotate-customer-dated-window.json pins the other arm. customer_probe_window_days is the diagnostic mirror of that rule (90 = defaulted window, null = the customer's own dates).
